summary: The page adheres strictly to the plan and contextual guidance. It methodically establishes risk tiering principles, objective evidence scope verification, multi-tiered approval gates, and time-bound conditional waivers. All citations from the ISO/IAF external providers guidance and the ICC Supplier Quality module page are accurately represented with appropriate disclaimers and demonstration-testing framing. Assigned roles, inputs, decisions, records, exceptions, evaluation criteria, and labeled illustrative examples are fully implemented, and boundary constraints are observed with no unassigned FAQ section.

glossary.definition: A temporary, time- or lot-limited authorization that permits procurement from an external provider while outstanding qualification requirements or audit action items are finalized under enhanced controls.
A mandatory sequential checkpoint within a supplier onboarding workflow that halts progression until designated functional stakeholders complete and record their verified sign-offs.
